conclusion.original: The actual product is integrable and its integral is i! times inner(u,v)^i if i=j, otherwise zero. The correlation is signed, not absolute valued.

There is no a.e. assertion about G values, no quotient-representative choice, no time/horizon and no limit. The zero-degree, equal/opposite-direction and negative-overlap cases are included as typed.
